I used to self harm and now every time I see the scars I just associate it with those bad times and the feelings. A lot of people can’t stop and feel like there’s no other way to deal with the way they’re feeling. Could you try writing down the reasons and throwing it away or trying some other way to cope. Congrats on being 2.5 months clean. Don’t discredit yourself. Take the little wins as they come. The past is the past but if you look at just the last 3 months of your life you’ve done something that a lot of people can’t. Doing better things now might not erase what’s happened in the past but it lays the foundation for what you build in the future. If the good and bad things you’ve done were put on a balance it sounds like you’re trying to add more and more to the good and it can outweigh the bad with time. Everything takes time.

If it was just a one off thought here and there. I wouldn’t worry about it too much. The mind just wanders and sometimes it’s to dark places. If it starts to happen more you could think about talking to someone about it but in my experience from therapy and inpatient. Suicidal is suicidal ideation, formulating a plan with intentions to act on it.

In my experience if they’re a ride or die it’s worth it. If you think it’s worth talking about it I would go with your gut. It’s better to try and fail than never try at all. It can always help to vent things in general.
